Subject: POC results + quick 30s quote or 10-min call?

Hi Alex / Smita —

Thanks again for running the week-long POC with us. We finished the final validation yesterday and I wanted to share a short, customer-facing summary of the outcomes (attached) and a quick ask. High-level results from the POC: 

- End-to-end inference latency (99p) improved from ~620ms to ~210ms after routing and batching tweaks.
- Token cost per 1k became 38% lower under the recommended quantization profile + cache.
- Throughput for peak windows increased 2.3x while keeping average latency within SLA.

Attached: redwood-poc-metrics-shopline.pdf — includes charts, config notes, and the sequence-length distribution we used for tuning.

Would you be comfortable sharing a one-paragraph quote we can use in a short case snippet, or alternatively hop on a 10-minute call so we can capture something on the spot? Example one-liner we can adapt: 

"Shopline reduced inference costs by 38% and saw a >2x throughput improvement during peak loads after the Redwood POC."

If a quote is easiest, even a 1–2 sentence blurb is perfect. If you prefer a call, I can send a 10-minute calendar invite later today or tomorrow morning.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership on this.

—
Kimberly Park

Thanks for sending this and for the team’s work — the metrics look great and match what our observability team reported during the trial. Happy to provide a short paragraph for your case snippet. Feel free to use the text below (you have permission to attribute to Shopline / Alex Johnson):
